name: Deepwater Tavern
summary: At Menethil Harbor, the Deepwater Tavern gives travelers a place to rest and find work. The inn is a meeting spot and resupply stop, where harbor rumors mingle with the chance of a brawl.

sections.title: Heart of Menethil Harbor
sections.body: In Menethil Harbor, the Deepwater Tavern shelters travelers from the marsh's rain and difficult roads. Sailors, dockworkers, merchants, and weary adventurers gather beneath its timber beams to trade news, meet, warm themselves, and patch their wounds. Local merchants and a resident first aid trainer serve those bound for the marsh or setting out across the Great Sea. The tavern is lively, and disputes over spilled ale can turn into brawls. Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn is known to spark them.

faq.q: Where is the Deepwater Tavern located?
faq.answer: The Deepwater Tavern stands near the waterfront of Menethil Harbor, the Wetlands' main port on Khaz Modan's western coast.

faq.q: What services are available inside the tavern?
aliases: what can i find at deepwater tavern
faq.answer: The tavern offers lodging and refreshments, along with local merchants and a resident first aid trainer. These make it a resupply and healing stop for adventurers traveling through the marshlands.

faq.q: Who frequently starts brawls in the tavern?
aliases: who starts fights at deepwater tavern
faq.answer: Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn, a shifty troublemaker, frequently starts brawls among the tavern's rowdy patrons and sailors.

faq.q: Why is the tavern so busy?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is a major shipping and naval gateway between Khaz Modan and Kalimdor. As the town's sole major inn, the Deepwater Tavern draws a steady flow of sailors, mercenaries, and Alliance adventurers heading into the Wetlands.

angles.text: As an Alliance member traveling between Ironforge and the open sea, you can use the Deepwater Tavern as an indispensable rallying point and place to rest.
